sloka: भिद्यतां भक्ष्यतां वापि शरीरं विसृजाम्यहम् ।न चाप्यहं चिरं दुःखं सहेयं प्रियवर्जिता ।। ५.२६.९।।।।
transliteration: bhidyatāṁ bhakṣyatāṁ vāpi śarīraṁ visṛjāmyaham ।na cāpyahaṁ ciraṁ duḥkhaṁ saheyaṁ priyavarjitā ।। 5.26.9।।।।

translations.english: "I will give up my body. Break me into pieces or eat me up. I cannot bear the sorrow of separation from my dear Rama any longer.
